item.title: Flocky Bird — Autonomous Flappy Bird via Genetic Algorithm
item.description:
Overview

Implemented an autonomous Flappy Bird agent trained using genetic algorithms to learn optimal gameplay strategies.

🔗 GitHub Repository

Key Features

  • Game Implementation: Built a Pygame version of Flappy Bird as the training environment

  • Neural Controller: Designed a simple fully connected neural network to control the bird’s actions

  • Evolutionary Training: Trained the network using a genetic algorithm with selection, crossover, and mutation operators

Results

The agent learns to navigate through pipes autonomously, demonstrating the effectiveness of evolutionary strategies for game AI.
